content:
# Ngôn ngữ hiển thị. File tương ứng nằm trong lang/ (vi_VN, en_US).
# Key thiếu sẽ tự fallback sang en_US.
language: vi_VN

team:
  max-name-length: 16
  max-tag-length: 6
  # Số thành viên cơ bản (cấp nâng cấp 0). Giới hạn thực = base + level*step.
  max-members: 30
  invite-ttl-seconds: 120

tiers:
  1:
    pages: 1
    member-limit: 5
    home-limit: 1
    price: 0
  2:
    pages: 3
    member-limit: 8
    home-limit: 2
    price: 50000
  3:
    pages: 5
    member-limit: 12
    home-limit: 3
    price: 150000
  4:
    pages: 7
    member-limit: 20
    home-limit: 5
    price: 200000

home:
  teleport-cooldown-seconds: 5
  teleport-warmup-seconds: 3
  warmup-cancel-on-move: true

stats:
  track-kills: true

chest:
  flush-interval-seconds: 300
  page-title: "&#f3a9c8&lRương Team &#ffd6e7- &#f7c6d9%team% &8(%page%/%pages%)"
